scope: SmartVio V18 optional app identity and future provider capability contract
currentAuthority: Hosted Sites dispatch; application source does not own OAuth callbacks, credentials or sessions

routes.GET /api/auth/config: Database-independent, no-store capability declaration. External providers remain configured:false, available:false, status:reserved and signInPath:null.
routes.GET /api/auth/session: Database-independent, no-store trusted platform session. Returns authenticated and only user.id/user.displayName; no contact data, role, token or user listing.
routes.GET /api/community/public: Always published-only, even with a hosting identity. viewer:null, mine:[], myComments:[]. Never inserts a community account.
routes.GET /api/community/state: Trusted identity retains its own submissions. Anonymous requests receive the same published-only view.
routes.POST /api/community/action: Requires trusted hosting identity and existing same-origin, disabled-user, content-policy and ownership validation. A local mode or X-Account-Id can never create an identity.

providers.chatgpt: Available through Sites-owned top-level sign-in and sign-out navigation
providers.google: Reserved; no live Google client configured or Google sign-in claim
providers.apple: Reserved; no live Apple client configured or Apple sign-in claim
providers.microsoft: Reserved; no live Microsoft client configured or Microsoft sign-in claim
providers.email: Reserved; no password storage, magic-link delivery or mail sender configured

futureProviderAdapter.activationPrerequisite: First confirm the hosting platform supports the external identity provider and configure it using supported server-side capabilities. Otherwise migrate identity through an explicitly designed and tested hosting change.

browserCapabilityShape.configured: boolean: true only after real configuration
browserCapabilityShape.available: boolean: true only when a supported live sign-in route exists
browserCapabilityShape.signInPath: null while reserved; otherwise a same-origin relative top-level platform navigation path

futureProviderAdapter.trustBoundary: Future provider identities must be verified and mapped server-side into stable site-scoped identity. Browser-supplied IDs, email strings, query parameters, bearer strings and app mode flags are not authentication.
futureProviderAdapter.secrets: Provider credentials belong in supported hosted runtime secret configuration, never the static bundle, repository, config response or report.
futureProviderAdapter.callbacks: Do not add a parallel OAuth/session implementation or override /signin-with-chatgpt, /signout-with-chatgpt or /callback while hosted Sites owns identity.
acceptanceBeforeEnable: Real provider redirect, cancellation and error handling
Same-origin safe return routes and callback/replay protections handled by the authority
Stable account mapping and deliberate account-linking policy
Guest features remain available and local drafts are not auto-published
Community private drafts and pending media remain isolated by server identity
Live sign-out/session expiry plus iPhone and Android browser verification

mediaReadPolicy: Anonymous images/video require a currently published post reference. Private/pending/hidden/deleted references grant no anonymous access; video must also be ready and not withdrawn. Existing no-store and same-origin resource policy remain.

localValidation.testEnvironment: Node built-in SQLite with actual generated migrations, isolated object-storage protocol substitute and frontend VM lifecycle harness
localValidation.notVerifiedByTheseTests: Live external provider login, anonymous access through private hosting audience, physical-device playback or real production account writes
